series.name: Imported Battle Log
series.note: Games are numbered oldest to newest. In each screenshot the lower game is the older one. Round 1 ends at Game 15, where MT reaches 8 wins. Round 2 holds sixteen fully visible games (m16 to m31) and ends at m31, where TheBeanWithDrip reaches 9 wins (MT 7, TheBeanWithDrip 9). Round 3 is first to 10 and holds eleven games (m32 to m42, from R3_Game1and2.PNG through R3_Game10and11.PNG): TheBeanWithDrip 10, MT 1 (MT's win is m38), so TheBeanWithDrip wins Round 3 at m42. The Round 3 placement of m32 to m42 is provisional, and games may be missing between m31 (5h 55min ago) and m32 (27min ago) and between m40 (4h 51min ago) and m41 (15h 3min ago). Round 4 is first to 10 and has eleven games so far (m43 to m53, from R4_Game1and2.PNG through R4_Game10and11.PNG): TheBeanWithDrip 10, MT 1 (MT's win is m45), so TheBeanWithDrip reaches the first-to-10 target at m53 and wins Round 4; the Round 4 start is inferred from Round 3 ending at m42. m50 to m53 were captured 50min to 36min before the screenshots (trophies MT 9062), so games may be missing between m49 and m50. Round 5 is first to 10 and has eleven games (m54 to m64, from R5_Game1and2.PNG through R5_Game11.PNG): TheBeanWithDrip 10, MT 1, so TheBeanWithDrip reaches the first-to-10 target at m64 and wins Round 5 (MT's win is m59); its start is inferred from Round 4 ending at m53 (36min ago, then m54 at 31min ago). m60 has no visible age label; m61 to m63 were captured in a later session (23h 54min, 23h 49min and 23h 45min before that screenshot, trophies unchanged). m64 (R5_Game11.PNG) has no visible age label and shows different trophies (MT 9185, Bean 7011), so it was captured later and games may be missing between m63 and m64; its placement as the final Round 5 game is provisional.
